title: Orbital Chunk delete cannon
description: Chunk Delete Cannon adds a one-use Chunk Delete Rod that deletes a chunk in one click
body:
What’s inside:

- chunkdeletecannon:chunk_delete_rod
- Fishing-rod-style item with max durability 1
- Survival recipe included in data/chunkdeletecannon/recipe
- /chunkrod give [targets] command is permission level 2/admin-only
- Any player can use the rod once they have it
- Server-side queued chunk clearing, 4,096 blocks per tick
